title: Finding
description: One defect raised by a review. Blocking findings gate closure. The triple (category, location, summary) is the finding's IDENTITY — the same defect raised by two reviewers produces the same triple, which is what lets a finding be tracked rather than merely restated. `digest` binds the finding to the bytes it judged: when the file changes the finding is stale, not resolved.

category.description: One lowercase word: correctness, security, scope, tests, a11y, perf. Part of the identity, so it must come from a small stable vocabulary rather than free text.

summary.description: The claim, in one line, as concrete inputs -> wrong output. Part of the identity.

failureScenario.description: concrete inputs or state leading to the wrong result

digest.description: cksum of the file at `location` when the finding was raised. A mismatch means STALE — the code changed and nobody re-checked. Written by scripts/finding.sh.

raisedAt.description: short commit sha the finding was raised against
